title: Sebastian and the Provision
author: Coral Delacroix
blurb: Paloma Lockridge, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when an expedition upriver stops answering the radio, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
